disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or renewing a license by use of fraud or material deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: obtaining or renewing a license by the use of fraud or material deception;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being professionally incompetent as manifested by poor standards of service
disciplinary_grounds.quote: being professionally incompetent as manifested by poor standards of service;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public in the course of professional services or activities;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a crime substantially related to practice, a felony, or a crime involving fraud or dishonesty
disciplinary_grounds.quote: being convicted of a crime that has a substantial relationship to his or her practice or an essential element of which is misstatement, fraud, or dishonesty, being convicted in this or another state of any crime that is a felony under the laws of Illinois or of that state, or being convicted of a felony in a federal court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any service in a grossly negligent manner or permitting a licensed employee to do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performing any service in a grossly negligent manner or permitting any licensed employee to perform services in a grossly negligent manner, regardless of whether actual damage or damage to the public is established;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully receiving compensation for professional services not actually rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully receiving compensation, directly or indirectly, for any professional service not actually rendered;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having disciplinary action taken against a license in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: having disciplinary action taken against his or her license in another State;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting or assisting unlicensed persons to perform services requiring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: contracting or assisting unlicensed persons to perform services for which a license is required under this Act;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting use of one's license to enable an unlicensed person or agency to operate as a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: permitting the use of his or her license to enable an unlicensed person or agency to operate as a licensee;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing and charging for services without authorization from the member of the public being served
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performing and charging for services without having authorization to do so from the member of the public being served;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with any provision of this Act or the rules adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to comply with any provision of this Act or the rules adopted under this Act.

insurance_required.quote: evidence of financial responsibility in a minimum amount of $1,000,000 through liability insurance, self-insurance, group insurance, group self-insurance, or risk retention groups that must include completed operations and environmental impairment;

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each licensee shall permit his or her facilities to be inspected by representatives of the Office of the State Fire Marshal.

definition_quote.value: "Petroleum equipment contractor" or "contractor" means a person, company, or corporation that installs, repairs, or removes underground storage tanks.
definition_quote.quote: "Petroleum equipment contractor" or "contractor" means a person, company, or corporation that installs, repairs, or removes underground storage tanks.

decommissioning of USTs including abandonment in place
methods_authorized.quote: The contractor must possess a license from the Office to perform the following types of activity: (1) installation of underground storage tanks; (2) repair of USTs, which shall include retrofitting and installation of cathodic protection systems; (3) decommissioning of USTs including abandonment in place; (4) relining of USTs; (5) tank and piping tightness testing; (6) testing of cathodic protection systems
